title: Daemon wire frame v1
description: Generated from @extalia/protocol by tooling/generate-schemas.mjs; do not edit. The TypeScript validators remain the reference. Validator-only checks: mission.create graph belongs to the mission; mission.snapshot unique task/lease IDs, task/holder/state lease correspondence and lease time order; TaskGraph unique task IDs, known references, acyclic dependsOn/parentTaskId and completed dependencies for started work; planning connection IDs sorted by ASCII order, inspection observation identity/digest correspondence and observation time not before admission; planning receipts grant no execution or settlement authority; routing preview status/count/score/identity/pin/rationale correspondence, report-wide exact revision metadata consistency and 512 KiB result budget; the checks of each nested contract; string lengths in UTF-16 code units (maxLength here counts code points).

Label.description: Nonblank text without control characters, at most 2000 UTF-16 code units.
